p.i: A revelation given through Joseph Smith Jr. at Hiram, Ohio, 1 December 1831, to Joseph Smith Jr. and Sidney Rigdon.

chapter.li: LEChapter71 Verse1 Behold, thus says the Lord unto you my servants, that the time has truly come that it is necessary and expedient in me that you should open your mouths in proclaiming my gospel, the things of the kingdom, expounding the mysteries thereof out of the scriptures, according to that portion of spirit and power which shall be given unto you, even as I will. VerseEnd Verse2 Truly I say unto you, proclaim unto the world in the regions round about, and in the church also, for the space of a season, even until it shall be made known unto you. VerseEnd Verse3 Truly, this is a mission for a season which I give unto you. VerseEnd Verse4 Wherefore, labor in my vineyard, call upon the inhabitants of the earth, and bear record, and prepare the way for the commandments and the revelations which are to come. VerseEnd

Verse5 Now behold, this is wisdom (whoever reads, let him understand and receive also, VerseEnd Verse6 for unto him who receives it shall be given more abundantly, even power) VerseEnd: Verse7 Wherefore, confound your enemies, call upon them to meet you, both in public and in private, and inasmuch as you are faithful, their shame shall be made manifest. VerseEnd Verse8 Wherefore, let them bring forth their strong reasons against the Lord. VerseEnd

Verse9 Truly thus says the Lord unto you: There is no weapon that is formed against you that shall prosper. VerseEnd Verse10 And if any man lift his voice against you, he shall be confounded in my own due time. VerseEnd Verse11 Wherefore, keep these commandments, for they are true and faithful. Even so, Amen. VerseEnd
